items.source: Provider for synchronous stateless MCP resource methods. This provider creates resource specifications for methods annotated with McpResource that are designed to work in a stateless manner using McpTransportContext.
items.translation: 同步无状态 MCP 资源方法的提供者。 此提供者为使用 McpTransportContext 以无状态方式运行的、带有 McpResource 注解的方法创建资源规范。

items.source: resourceObjects - the objects containing methods annotated with McpResource
items.translation: resourceObjects - 包含用 McpResource 注解的方法的对象。

items.source: Christian Tzolov, Alexandros Pappas, Vadzim Shurmialiou, Craig Walls
